== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Furman is an [[assistant]] and servant who works closely with the alchemist Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius. In his professional capacity, he performs various administrative and logistical tasks, such as taking notes on a clipboard, managing velvet bags containing silver and gold coins, and making records of specific requests. He is also responsible for preparing rooms and coordinating with Alchemists{{!}}alchemists and mercenaries to implement contingency plans during events. While he often appears as a quiet presence behind his employer, Furman has demonstrated the ability to act decisively, such as when he pushed Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius to the deck and later attempted to escape by diving overboard during a capture.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Furman is an exact duplicate of Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius. He possesses a physical appearance that is identical to his master.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Furman is an alchemist and a [[Mason]]. He serves as an [[assistant]] and helps lead the group of Alchemists{{!}}alchemists alongside Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius.}}
